description: This PHP source file defines the CopyProjectActivityAPI class, which is an API endpoint for copying project activities between projects within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It provides methods for listing copyable activities, copying activities from one project to another, and defining validation rules for these operations.

classes.name: CopyProjectActivityAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for copying project activities between projects within the time management module of OrangeHRM. Implements listing and copying functionalities with validation rules.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list copyable activities between two projects, including sorting, pagination, and duplication detection.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to copy selected activities from one project to another, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented, throws exception if called.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the GET request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the POST request body.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented, throws exception if called.

methods.name: getCommonURLValidationRules
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the URL parameters: toProjectId and fromProjectId.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Extracts URL attributes (project IDs) from the request parameters.
